name: Loading indicator
purpose: An animated spinner that signals the system is working on a request, giving progress feedback for activities such as downloading, uploading or processing. Indeterminate (no percentage).

props.name: size
props.$note: Web offers all four; iOS & Android offer large/medium/extra-small (no small).
props.$status: s142-D1 (Dave, 2026-08-10) class C2 -- bind:icon-ramp-map. Size enum binds to the icon-scale ramp. Exact/standard-abbreviation match to all four icon-scale rungs (extra-small -> xsmall) -- cleanly grounded. Record: reviews/BINDS-AUTHORING-VERDICTS-2026-08-10-s142-v3.json.

props.name: mode
props.$status: s142-D1 (Dave, 2026-08-10) class C7 -- no-bind:theme-layer. Duplicates the theme layer (four-themes standing requirement) and would fork against it; the theme layer owns this, not a per-component prop. Record: reviews/BINDS-AUTHORING-VERDICTS-2026-08-10-s142-v3.json.

tokens.spinner: icon/default (#333333) on light | icon/default-reverse (#ffffff) on dark
tokens.label: text/default | text/reverse @ font-5/regular or font-6/regular
tokens.$note: The rotating arc is a vector animation; only the stroke colour is tokenised.

mustNotNeighbour: another Loading indicator (only one on screen at a time)

accessibility.announce: A tag/label MUST be added so screen readers announce what is happening while the indicator animates (don't rely on the visual spin alone)
accessibility.skeletonAltText: Skeleton loaders need proper alternative text — an alt attribute for static text, or an aria live-region for dynamic updates
accessibility.motion: REVIEW (inferred): continuous animation should respect prefers-reduced-motion
accessibility.status: Expose as a status/progressbar role (indeterminate) with an accessible name

antiPatterns: Showing more than one spinner on screen at the same time (ambiguous about what is loading)
Animating without an accessible label/status so AT users get no feedback
REVIEW (inferred): using an indeterminate spinner where a determinate progress bar (known duration) would be clearer

usage.centring: Centre the spinner within its container. If the container's final height is unknown because content is still loading, centre horizontally only.
usage.platformParity: Web / iOS / Android variants exist; pick the platform-native one.

tokenValidation.against: token store re-based on Figma native variable export
tokenValidation.result: PASS — CLEAN, no deprecated tokens. Spinner = icon/default / icon/default-reverse; label = text/default / text/reverse (font-5/6 regular).

depricateUsage.note: None — fully migrated across Web/iOS/Android, on-light/dark.

mustNotNeighbour.$note: another Loading indicator (only one on screen at a time)
